observations: Single photo shows a black console with the PlayStation triangle/square/circle/X-like logo area visible on the top edge.
Shape and glossy top strip are consistent with the original 'fat' PS4 (CUH-10xx/11xx) design.
No controller, cables, power brick, or box is visible in the photo.
No model/serial plate is visible or readable.
No photo of ports, rear panel, or screen-on state to confirm function.

claims.evidence: No markings, import sticker, or region plate visible in photo 0 to confirm origin.

claims.claim: with one original wireless controller and other accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only the console; no controller or accessories are visible in the image.
No games or discs shown in photo.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal fault (common HDD/APU issues in used PS4 units).
risks.proof: A short video of the console powering on, showing the home screen and a disc or game loading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-working console (parts/repair value only)

risks.risk: Claimed wireless controller and accessories may not actually be included.
risks.proof: A photo showing the controller, power cable, HDMI cable, and any other listed accessories alongside the console.

risks.risk: Disc drive or HDMI port damage not visible from the single front-angle photo.
risks.proof: Photos of the rear ports and disc slot, plus a clip of a disc being inserted and read.

risks.risk: Unverifiable 'UK used' origin claim, which can affect perceived quality/voltage compatibility.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear label showing model number and voltage/region markings.

proof_requests: Photo of the console powered on (home screen visible).
Photo showing the controller and all included accessories together with the console.
Photo of the rear panel including ports and the serial/model sticker.
Short video of a disc being loaded and played, if disc-based games are included.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a standard-shaped PS4 console, but with no proof of included controller, accessories, or working condition, it must be priced at worst case as a console-only, unverified-function unit.
